plan_warnings: The English is a condensed translation: it omits the soldier waiting (P2), the inn and the watching (P5), the crowd drawing near (P6), the chief's order and the scandal (P7, P8). Both texts are kept verbatim; chunk meanings therefore do not always line up.
There are almost no pauses in the narration, so sound effects must be few and very soft (see implementation notes).
The soldier/guard costume preset is planned but not yet in the Library; it is the largest new drawing here.
Up to nine people share the hall in S5 to S9 and S14 to S20: use two depth rows (y 870 and y 930), s 0.78 to 0.9, and check that no lettering or balloon covers a face.
S11 is dense (palm, wall and a full day and night in 6.5 s); if it reads as rushed, drop the palm gag and keep the wall.
